  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS -JANUARY 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2124- DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2124]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  1A)          Implement the logic function using an 8x1 MUX  
  $$F(A, B, C, D) = Σ m (1, 3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15)                                          (4)$$  
  
  1B)          Design a full subtractor using a Decoder and logic gates. Explain its working principle  
  (3)  
  
  1C)          Implement a two-input NAND gate with Transistor Transistor Logic (TTL)  
  (3)  
  
  2A)          Design a code converter to convert a 3 bit binary to gray code  
  (4)  
  
  2B)          Design a Mod- 10 Ripple up counter using T Flipflop  
  (3)  
  
  2C)          Derive the characteristic equation of SR flipflop. Convert SR flipflop to D flipflop  
  (3)  
  
  3A)          Design a sequence detector to detect 101 with overlapping using Melay model with  
  positive edge triggered D flip flop                                                        (4)  
  
  3B)          Design synchronous mod 8 up counter using T flip flop  
  (3)  
  
  3C)          Write dataflow Verilog code for the 2:4 decoder  
  (3)  
  
  4A)          Write the Structural Verilog code for 4 bit parallel adder  
  (4)  
  
  4B)          Write the Sequential verilog code for positive edge triggered JK Flipflop  
  (3)  
  
  4C)          Write the Verilog code for a 3 input XOR gate as a user defined primitive (UDP)  
  (3)  
  
  5A)          Implement 3-bit counter using ACT-3(S-module) FPGA. The logic expression of the  
  counter are as follows  
  (4)
